queries: WITH g AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaininggb, AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) AS avg_abs_cpu_gpu_diff FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT g.*, AVG(avg_remaininggb) OVER () AS mean_of_avgs FROM g) SELECT zoneref, insurstat, avg_remaininggb, avg_abs_cpu_gpu_diff, avg_remaininggb / mean_of_avgs AS ratio_to_mean FROM m WHERE mean_of_avgs IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (avg_remaininggb / mean_of_avgs) IS NULL, avg_remaininggb / mean_of_avgs DESC LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaingb, AVG(ABS(p.proccpu - p.procgpu)) AS avg_abs_cpu_gpu_diff FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaingb) AS mean_avg_remaingb FROM g) SELECT g.zoneref, g.insurstat, g.avg_remaingb, g.avg_abs_cpu_gpu_diff, g.avg_remaingb / m.mean_avg_remaingb AS remaingb_ratio FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_avg_remaingb IS NOT NULL ORDER BY remaingb_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (
  SELECT sp.zoneref AS site_code,
         s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
         AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb,
         AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) AS avg_abs_cpu_gpu_diff
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
), m AS (
  SELECT g.*, AVG(avg_remaining_gb) OVER () AS mean_of_avgs
  FROM g
)
SELECT site_code,
       insurance_status,
       avg_remaining_gb,
       avg_abs_cpu_gpu_diff,
       avg_remaining_gb / NULLIF(mean_of_avgs, 0) AS remaining_ratio
FROM m
WHERE mean_of_avgs IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY remaining_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: An inner join to sites keeps only processing records with a matching site. Groups whose average remaining storage is NULL still count as groups and appear with a NULL ratio, but they are left out of the mean of group averages.
Ties in the ratio are broken arbitrarily because the request gives no tie-breaker.

responses.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaingb, AVG(ABS(p.proccpu - p.procgpu)) AS avg_abs_cpu_gpu_diff FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaingb) AS mean_avg_remaingb FROM g) SELECT g.zoneref, g.insurstat, g.avg_remaingb, g.avg_abs_cpu_gpu_diff, g.avg_remaingb / m.mean_avg_remaingb AS remaingb_ratio FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_avg_remaingb IS NOT NULL ORDER BY remaingb_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The ratio's denominator is the unweighted mean of the per-group average remaingb values. It is not the overall row-level average. Groups whose average is NULL are skipped, and a zero mean would give a NULL or error ratio.
The inner join to sites keeps only processing records whose site exists. Each site code appears in only one group because zoneregistry is the primary key.
The absolute difference is computed per row, and rows where either proccpu or procgpu is NULL are ignored in that average.

WITH g AS (
  SELECT sp.zoneref AS site_code,
         s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
         AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb,
         AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) AS avg_abs_cpu_gpu_diff
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
), m AS (
  SELECT g.*, AVG(avg_remaining_gb) OVER () AS mean_of_avgs
  FROM g
)
SELECT site_code,
       insurance_status,
       avg_remaining_gb,
       avg_abs_cpu_gpu_diff,
       avg_remaining_gb / NULLIF(mean_of_avgs, 0) AS remaining_ratio
FROM m
WHERE mean_of_avgs IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY remaining_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Groups whose average remaining storage is NULL (all remaingb missing) are still returned, with a NULL ratio, and sort last. They are excluded from the overall mean.
If the mean of group averages is exactly 0, the ratio is treated as missing (NULL) rather than raising a division error.
